<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>CEC Impeachment:</strong> Opposition parties are coordinating to move an impeachment motion against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar following reports of internal dissent and alleged procedural irregularities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I37</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Appointment Law Challenge:</strong> The Supreme Court has referred the legal challenge against the 2023 Election Commissioner appointment law to a five-judge Constitution bench to examine concerns regarding executive influence.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPMjlMakhHX19GWHJYWWlnZVhObzJNLTJrY0ZLaU1Zdy1obW8xNjhJV0x3SmFHajlGV09lbXFHS25DX1NxclJrSWd4LUJCaWZreHI4ZzF1Q1lIVTFubkxsMVREUC1nS1BaaDRUblRRdUZqQ1NjazJSZGV3eVFiWGxXZHZLTjBsQkRLVTV4U0d2eUtkWTlDYXpBOU51TDA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission Oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed the Election Commission to provide a firm timeline for resolving the Trinamool Congress name and symbol dispute, citing the need to avoid delays similar to those seen in the Shiv Sena case.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Internal Dissent:</strong> Reports indicate that Election Commissioners have formally objected to poll panel decisions on 14 separate occasions over the past ten months, fueling ongoing political controversy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP Organizational Changes:</strong> The BJP has initiated a restructuring of its national organization by appointing new state general secretaries and joint general secretaries across various regions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a></span></li>
</ul>
